title: Unit test for an untested util
request: Find one small pure utility in src/utils that has no unit test and add a focused unit test. Test-only. No product code changes.

criteria.text: Strings starting with = + - @ tab or CR come back with a leading apostrophe
Safe strings (Team A, empty, a=b, leading space) are unchanged
Numbers (-5, 0, 3.14) come back unchanged as numbers
Already-prefixed string is unchanged (pins current behavior)
New test file passes; typecheck, lint, unit gates pass on the final commit
